B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction and mixed-number subtraction with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus a fraction with numerator 0.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fractional parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the subtraction step may produce a zero or negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding an LCD or rewriting forms.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole-number part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units such as 5/5, 10/10, or 24/24.
Tag when borrowing is used after a fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as having 0 fractional parts.
Do not tag direct subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms or to an integer when the fractional part is zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that merely produce the unsimplified result.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification also occurs in that step.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer representation.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as a simple fraction.
Tag when a mixed-number result is written after subtraction and any needed simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps that do not assemble the final answer form.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final representation.
Do not tag initial rewrites used to prepare for subtraction.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators are unlike.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part unless a denominator conversion is also performed.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper mixed-number part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding an LCD or converting forms before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole-number part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as denominator/denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used after obtaining a negative fractional difference or anticipating it.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as 0 over a denominator before subtraction unless a borrow/regroup occurs.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction/whole-number result to its simplest form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by common factors.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce an already simplified result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly performed.
Do not tag normalization of operands before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as just a fraction.
Tag when a mixed-number computation is concluded by writing the final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure-fraction items that end immediately with a single subtraction statement unless a separate combine step is shown.
Do not tag simplification-only steps that reduce a fraction but do not recombine parts.
Do not tag operand rewrites done before subtraction.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator pure fractions or mixed-number fraction parts that must be aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form with standard whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when the rewrite is done to enable part-by-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of proper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution performs part-by-part subtraction of whole and fraction components.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding or creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification of the result after subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator, such as 12/12 or 5/5, and added to the existing fraction part.
Tag when the regrouping is used to replace a negative fractional difference with a valid mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number part before subtraction.
Do not tag straightforward subtraction when no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction part into an integer or whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produced the unsimplified fraction.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts if no reduction or simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.

skills.name: Compose final result
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one final answer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction result.
Tag when the final answer is stated as a mixed number or integer after part-by-part work.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps that have not yet assembled the final form.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final expression.
Do not tag initial rewrites of operands.
